topNews.text: French Polynesia Protects Biodiverse Ocean Area Twice the Size of Arizona Teeming with Life

topNews.text: New Solar Method Turns Ocean Into Drinking Water, While Extracting Valuable Lithium Without Waste
topNews.excerpt: A new energy-efficient desalination system produces fresh water without chemical additives and transforms leftover salts into useful materials. Communities from California to the Middle East currently rely on desalination plants to convert ocean water to fresh water.
